name: Context Prime
description: Load project context by reading README.md and listing tracked files. Use at the start of a session to get oriented.
description_zh: 读取 README.md 并列出受版本管理的文件，在会话开始时快速熟悉项目。
prompt: Read README.md, then run `git ls-files` (with `shell`) to list the tracked files and understand the context of the project. Skip build output, vendored and generated directories.
